content_of_post_to_answer: What school habit helped you succeed later in life?
answer: The school habit that often pays off later is learning to sit with confusion instead of immediately seeking answers. Many students focus on getting the right solution, but the deeper skill is becoming comfortable with the process of figuring things out. That habit builds independence in work, relationships, and decisions. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for those who want to go deeper. The best learners are not those who know the most, but those who keep learning when they don’t know.
